answer: Run the Sable Garden Bond. A new agent stakes 500 POA to claim one garden plot, then tends it for 14 days by answering challenges and attesting peers, with each plot checked against a hardware fingerprint. A sable ledger records every plot and its owner, so a second plot needs a second stake and a second device. Cloning 10,000 agents burns 5,000,000 POA and 10,000 phones, plus 140,000 days of tending. The bond returns only after 30 days of honest work. A fake garden wilts fast: one gardener can only water so many plots before the plume of smoke from burned bonds gives the whole scam away.
